title: AI and Cultural Context: An Empirical Investigation of Large Language Models' Performance on Chinese Social Work Professional Standards
findings: This paper does not present any findings related to religion. Its focus is on the performance of LLMs on Chinese social work standards and the cultural biases observed between Chinese and Western contexts. The paper cites another study's finding that some LLMs exhibit cultural values similar to those in Protestant European countries as background evidence for Western bias in models.

measurement_description: The paper does not measure any aspect of faith or religion. The benchmark measures LLM performance on Chinese Social Work Professional Standards, focusing on jurisprudence and applied knowledge within a Chinese cultural context versus a Western one.
